messages.subject: Re: upload data
parts:
The data is copied as a temp file. If you want to keep it, you have to copy it somewhere more permanent. In your server.R you could do something like:

observe({
  if (!is.null(input$file1)) {
    file.copy(input$file1$datapath, tempfile(tmpdir="~/uploads/", fileext=".csv"))
  }
})


On Thu, Oct 17, 2013 at 8:23 PM, Brent <brent...@gmail.com> wrote:
As a follow-up: I am using the upload data widget in the Shiny tutorial. That app is displaying the data in the app, but it's not saving to my folder on the RStudio Server.


On Thursday, October 17, 2013 9:14:25 PM UTC-4, Brent wrote:
Just got my shiny hosting account. I already created an app that runs locally.

I'm sure this is simple, but how do I upload my data to RStudio Server? My data is currently a .csv file stored on my hard drive.

Thanks.
